Qualification attempt — 2026-10-07 (local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007)

PHRF-15 remains open. Removed quadratic voxel-domain setup and per-cell reader index-vector materialization. B0 preparation falls from observed 161.510/151.790 seconds to 1.745/0.888 seconds in final baseline/repaired repeats; this is a source-confirmed complexity repair with exploratory before/after timings, not controlled benchmark medians.

At V=100000, N=300, 8 workers and 256-voxel blocks, final baseline attempts 56992 in 120.067 execution seconds and emits none. Repaired multistart attempts 404 in 122.274 seconds (56 decoder accepted, 276 Boundary, 72 CurvatureNotPositive); no complete block is delivered before cancellation. N=1200, V=10000 attempts 32 Boundary refusals in 147.754 seconds. Deadlines are checked between voxels; workers are drained. Original-family certification is excluded and unavailable. No full workload time is extrapolated.

Process heap sampling is not engine live memory. The source-based simultaneous-reference scenario at N=1200 reaches 256.85 MiB with eight first-order references or 321.04 MiB with eight full-jet references, before excluded scratch, blocks, metadata and headers. Actual engine peak, complete certified timings, fixed-shape denominators, JS throughput and crossovers remain unresolved. Host is M2 Pro/macOS15.1.1/JDK21/Node24, not the frozen reference host.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-qualification-20261007/README.md and certification-audit.md; 41 source/artifact hashes verified.
